calibration_sources: NVIDIA DGX SuperPOD Rail-Optimized Topology & NCCL PXN (PCIe x NVLink Cross-Rail Proxy) Architecture
3-Tier Clos Fat-Tree vs. 2-Tier Rail-Only / Slimmed Spine Optical Transceiver & Hop Latency Models
3D MEMS Optical Circuit Switching (OCS) & Dragonfly+ AI Cluster Interconnect Benchmarks

workload.cluster_scale: 4,096 GPUs (512 Nodes x 8 GPUs/node x 8 400Gbps RDMA NICs = 400 GB/s unidirectional line rate per node)
workload.pxn_mechanism: NCCL PXN (PCIe x NVLink): GPU 0 on Node A routes via 900 GB/s intra-node NVSwitch to GPU 3/NIC 3 on Node A, reaching GPU 3 on Node B in 1 Rail-Switch hop
workload.ocs_dragonfly_advantage: Eliminates active Core electrical switches & DSP optical transceivers via 3D MEMS OCS / Dragonfly+ direct optical groups

tiers.name: Tier 1: 2:1 超订传统云数据中心 Spine-Leaf 拓扑 (ECMP 哈希碰撞 + 上行拥塞 -> 集合通信带宽跌至 154 GB/s)
tiers.name_en: Tier 1: 2:1 Oversubscribed Traditional Cloud Spine-Leaf (154.0 GB/s Collective BW · 34.2% MFU)
tiers.fabric_topology_and_routing: 8 NICs per node into local ToR with 2:1 uplink oversubscription to Spine switches
tiers.cross_rail_and_collective_path: Cross-rack AllReduce & MoE All-to-All saturate 50% uplink bisection bandwidth and trigger PFC pauses
tiers.recommended_for: General CPU cloud storage/web traffic only; wastes $14M+/yr of GPU time if used for synchronous LLM training.

tiers.name: Tier 2: 标准 1:1 全无阻塞三层胖树 (3-Tier Clos Fat-Tree · 节点对齐接入 · 5 跳延迟 3.8us · 12,288 个光模块)
tiers.name_en: Tier 2: Standard 1:1 Non-Blocking 3-Tier Clos Fat-Tree (336.0 GB/s BW · 12,288 Optics · $18.4M CAPEX)
tiers.fabric_topology_and_routing: All 8 NICs of a node plug into the same Leaf switch; requires full 3-tier Core/Spine/Leaf hierarchy at 4,096 Ports
tiers.cross_rail_and_collective_path: Every inter-rack flow traverses Leaf -> Spine -> Core -> Spine -> Leaf (5 switch hops, 3.8us latency)
tiers.recommended_for: Legacy non-NVSwitch clusters where GPUs inside a node cannot proxy traffic for each other.

tiers.name: Tier 3: 轨优化胖树 (Rail-Optimized Fat-Tree) + NCCL PXN 机内 NVSwitch 跨轨代理 (1跳直达 · 省 $5.8M 光模块)
tiers.name_en: Tier 3: Rail-Optimized Fat-Tree + NCCL PXN NVSwitch Proxy (369.6 GB/s · 1.1us · $12.6M CAPEX)
tiers.fabric_topology_and_routing: NIC i of 64 nodes connects to Rail-Leaf Switch i; 78% of DP/PP/EP traffic stays within 1-hop Rail switches
tiers.cross_rail_and_collective_path: NCCL PXN hops over 900 GB/s intra-node NVSwitch to target rail's local NIC, turning 5-hop Core routes into 1 Rail hop!
tiers.recommended_for: Industry-standard production 1K-16K GPU clusters (DGX SuperPOD / RoCEv2 Rail-Optimized pods).

tiers.name: Tier 4: 轨优化高基数交换 + 3D MEMS 光电路交换 (OCS) / Dragonfly+ 动态光脊拓扑 (383.2 GB/s · 省电 46.5%)
tiers.name_en: Tier 4: Rail-Optimized High-Radix + 3D MEMS OCS / Dragonfly+ Dynamic Spine (383.2 GB/s · 0.76MW · $10.6M)
tiers.fabric_topology_and_routing: High-radix Rail-Leaf switches interconnected via passive 3D MEMS Optical Circuit Switches (OCS) / Dragonfly+ groups
tiers.cross_rail_and_collective_path: Eliminates Core O-E-O optical transceivers, reconfigures job-aware topology in 15ms, and achieves 95.8% line rate
tiers.recommended_for: Next-gen 4K-32K GPU AI Factories optimizing CAPEX (-$7.8M), optics power (-46.5%), and optical fault healing.
